name: agentmemory
description: Persistent local memory for Claude. Hooks record prompts, tool calls and replies to a separately installed agentmemory server on your machine; skills and 54 MCP tools search and manage that memory. No outside AI provider is used unless you enable one.

agentmemory_url.title: agentmemory server URL
agentmemory_url.description: Where the hooks and MCP server reach your agentmemory server. Leave empty to use AGENTMEMORY_URL from your environment when it is set, otherwise http://localhost:3111. A remote server must use https.

agentmemory_secret.title: agentmemory server secret
agentmemory_secret.description: Only needed for a remote agentmemory server. Leave empty for a server on this machine; the plugin then reads the local server's own secret and never sends it off this machine.
